quest.rewards_formatted: Recipe: Magma Eggs x1, Delicious Magma Eggs x3, Magma Eggs x5, Suspicious Magma Eggs x10

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure, I'll give it a go!

dialogues.speaker: Runtuma
dialogues.text: So, about them — they're a dish that can only be produced in our volcanic region.

dialogues.speaker: Runtuma
dialogues.text: We toss some bird eggs on the vents, let the Phlogiston roast them, and when the heat and timing are just right, out comes the perfect Magma Egg.

dialogues.speaker: Runtuma
dialogues.text: But word to the wise — leave it in too long, and it'll take on a, ah, special taste.

dialogues.speaker: Runtuma
dialogues.text: Sweet moves, you two! You finished the challenge in no time at all.

dialogues.speaker: Runtuma
dialogues.text: Now, let me check — whoa, that color and smell... I'm getting hungry already! Go ahead, try it while it's hot!

dialogues.speaker: Runtuma
dialogues.text: Oh, and here's the recipe. Next time you're craving Magma Eggs, well, you'll know how to make them!

dialogues.speaker: Runtuma
dialogues.text: Greetings, travelers from afar! Have you ever heard of the Magma Egg, one of the specialties we have here at the Collective of Plenty?

dialogues.speaker: Runtuma
dialogues.text: If you wanna try one, just take on the "Magma Egg Challenge"! Get to that geothermal vent over there, break it open, grab the egg inside, and bam, you've got yourself a fresh, hot delicacy!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry, I have something else to do.

dialogues.speaker: Runtuma
dialogues.text: Alright, don't forget to come back and give it a try whenever you have the time!

dialogues.speaker: Runtuma
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you two, skillful travelers from afar! Have you tried making Magma Eggs yourselves?

choices.text: I did! It was a super energizing dish!

response.speaker: Runtuma
response.text: Right? That's the power of volcanic goodness packed into every bite!

response.speaker: Runtuma
response.text: They say you'll get stronger and stronger if you eat 'em every day!

choices.text: I overcooked mine... almost passed out after eating it.

response.speaker: Runtuma
response.text: Haha, that taste really sticks with you, huh?

response.speaker: Runtuma
response.text: Honestly, it's not that bad once you get used to it.

response.speaker: Runtuma
response.text: No worries, that's fine. Hope the rest of your journey goes smoothly!
